title: Yapcrafters
description: YapCrafters – cross-play Minecraft server with Survival (land claims, shops) and Creative. 100% no pay-to-win. Friendly community, new players welcome!
body:
# YapCrafters – Minecraft for Everyone

Welcome to YapCrafters, a friendly server that has been running for over a year with a welcoming community. We offer full cross-play – whether you play on Java, Bedrock, PC, console, or mobile, you're invited to join the fun.

## Our Worlds

- **Survival:** Classic survival with land claims, ChestShops, and a friendly community.
- **Creative:** Build freely on large plots with PlotSquared and integrated WorldEdit.

## Fair Play

**100% no pay‑to‑win.** All gameplay features can be earned for free. Our ranks exist only to support the server – they provide cosmetic perks, chat commands, and small conveniences, never an unfair advantage.

## How to Join

- **Java:** `mc.yapcrafters.com`
- **Bedrock:** Add `YapCrafters` on consoles, or use IP `mc.yapcrafters.com` port `19132` on mobile/Windows.

## Stay Updated

Join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/d7rqbVpv4m) for news, events, and support.
